rows.grounds: genitive plural of brahmādi (brahma and others)
fused sandhi form cihnaṃ-dhārayaṃtyaḥ-prakīrtitāḥ; mark-bearing ones proclaimed
compound raktavarṇa (red color) masculine nominative singular

items.question: Which beings are proclaimed as bearing the supreme mark of brahma and others and having red color?
premises: Brahma and others have a supreme mark.
Those bearing that mark are proclaimed.
items.inference: The red-colored mark-bearers are the proclaimed associates of brahma and others.
uncertainties: Fused token cihnaṃdhārayaṃtyaḥprakīrtitāḥ requires sandhi parsing; exact grammatical agreement uncertain.
items.plain_english: Those proclaimed as bearing the supreme mark of brahma and the rest are red-colored.
